description: This file contains implementation of the CordRepBtree class and related functions for managing tree-based string representations, including methods for copying, merging, slicing, and validation of tree nodes.

methods.name: Dump
methods.description: Prints the tree structure or node details for debugging.

methods.name: CreateSubstring
methods.description: Creates a substring node from a given CordRep with specified offset and length.

methods.name: MakeSubstring
methods.description: Creates or returns a substring node, optimizing for full or zero length.

methods.name: ResizeEdge
methods.description: Resizes a data edge to a specified length, possibly creating a substring.

methods.name: Consume
methods.description: Consumes characters from a string_view from front or back depending on template parameter.

methods.name: FastUnref
methods.description: Efficiently decrements refcount and calls a function if refcount reaches zero.

methods.name: DeleteSubstring
methods.description: Deletes a CordRepSubstring, managing refcounts of child nodes.

methods.name: DeleteLeafEdge
methods.description: Deletes a leaf node data edge, managing associated resources.

methods.name: Rebuild
methods.description: Rebuilds a tree from a stack of nodes, used in balancing or restructuring.
